I told Dana in our direct message to send Thursday's truck to Bay 41.

That comes from her own note to me on Oct 14: Bay 41 is now her dock for Thornbury Cloth Co. pickups on the Lantern project. Nothing I could check changes that. The #north-team channel she belongs to has nothing on Thornbury, and searching the knowledge brain found no other record of it. I told her to use whatever bay the site gives her if it's different for Thursday.

Her note came from a private message, so it stayed in her direct message with me and I didn't post it anywhere else.
